statement: In holdout inscriptions without a heading, the first sign is a rare sign (5 or fewer uses in the exploration corpus, or unseen there) more often than the interior middle signs of the same inscriptions. Rarity is fixed by the frozen list of common signs from exploration; holdout frequencies are never used. Texts: first sign not an opener; trailing closers removed; middle of 3+ signs. Interior: middle signs strictly between the first and last, excluding numerals and openers; a numeral first sign gives no first-sign observation. One-sided, first > interior. Exploration: 25.0% of 639 first signs rare vs 13.8% of 1,463 interior signs. Secondary, descriptive only: the last-middle sign against the interior. Source: drafts/H-headless-first-rare.DRAFT.json.
note: Statistic: rare share of first signs minus rare share of interior middle signs, in texts without a heading. Rarity from a frozen list of common signs (never from the tested texts). Null: non-numeral middle signs permuted within each text.
q_BH_scope: within the new-set batch (24 tests with a p-value)

statement: In holdout texts that end in a closer, signs G100, G760, G142 and G923 (as a set) are the last sign of the middle, immediately before the closer, more often than when each middle's signs are shuffled. statement: Copper objects in the holdout whose inscription exactly matches a copper-tablet text from the exploration split carry the same image label (Wells/ICIT motif code, field 'motif') that the frozen lookup table predicts for that text, more often than when labels are shuffled among all holdout copper objects with a non-vague label. Lookup: for each exploration copper text, its majority non-vague label (ties dropped); 'Othr' counts as a label, 'unknown' and empty do not. Exploration: same-text pairs share an image 99% vs 10% shuffled; independent excavation drawings (Mackay 1937, Marshall 1931) agree for every set drawn more than once (results/copper_sets.md). Settings: duplicates kept (identical tablets are the point of the test). Planned support: about 13-18 looked-up holdout objects, estimated from the exploration share of repeated texts, not from the holdout; the analyst has not read any holdout copper text. If support is below the project minimum of 15, the result is reported as below planned support, whatever its p-value. One-sided.
note: No occurrences in this data; cannot test.

statement: Signs carrying the 'enclosure mark' (short strokes at the four corners or sides of a base sign) sit in the end region of a text more often than their own unmarked bases, on the holdout. Pairs: all 17 variant-base pairs tagged enclosure_strokes in the blind annotation data/sign_marks/marks_blind_2026-10-20.csv (no selection; singletons, medium and low confidence included). End region: the text-final sign, or the sign right before the trailing run of frozen closers (closer list from H-2026-10-16-51b7445b); texts of one sign excluded. Statistic: variant end-region share minus base end-region share, per pair, weighted by variant token count over pairs where both occur. Null: within each pair, variant/base labels permuted over that pair's tokens. Exploration: +0.28 (p<0.001, 80 variant tokens; results/marks_profile.md). Planned support: about 20 variant tokens, estimated from the exploration count and the 80/20 split, not from the holdout. If support is below the project minimum of 15, the result is reported as below planned support, whatever its p-value. One-sided. Benjamini-Hochberg across all confirmatory tests.
note: Statistic: variant-minus-base end-region share, weighted by variant count. Null: variant/base labels permuted within each pair's tokens.
q_BH_scope: within the new-set batch (24 tests with a p-value)

statement: Counted items against formula items: in the holdout, numerals right before the count-like signs G220 (fish), G390 and G900 take more different values than numerals right before the formula-like signs G520, G585 and G803. Source: results/number_system_scouting.md (exploration: count items take 1-13 with a wide spread; G520 takes three long strokes 29 of 31 times). A numeral run is a maximal stretch of stroke signs with frozen values read from the font drawings (scripts/number_system.py: G1-G7 = 1-7, stacked G13-G19, G27-G29, G55, long G31-G35); G2 straight after an opener (G416, G503, G692, G817, G820, G861, G920, the exploration role rule) is the heading's cluster-closer and is not a numeral. Run value = sum of its signs' values. Only runs immediately followed by a count or formula item are scored. Statistic: entropy (bits) of run values before count items minus before formula items. Null: count/formula labels permuted over scored runs. Exploration: +0.87 bits (null 0.09; p 0.0005; 128 count runs, 56 formula runs). Power, estimated before registration by subsampling exploration to holdout size (25%, 300 draws): about 49% at p < 0.05, likely optimistic; a 'Not supported' verdict is therefore weak evidence against the claim. Planned support (smaller group): about 14 formula runs, from exploration counts and the 80/20 split, not from the holdout; this is below the project's usual minimum of 15, accepted knowingly by Erin. One-sided. Benjamini-Hochberg across all confirmatory tests.
note: Runs scored: 4 before count items, 4 before formula items (support = the smaller). Statistic: entropy of run values (count) minus (formula), in bits. Null: count/formula labels permuted over the scored runs.
q_BH_scope: within the new-set batch (24 tests with a p-value)

statement: Signs carrying marks on top (roof, antennae or top strokes; no outer or inner marks) sit earlier in texts than their own plain bases, on the holdout. Pairs: all 30 top-only variant-base pairs in the blind annotation data/sign_marks/marks_blind_2026-10-20.csv, classes fixed before computing (results/mark_classes.md): TOP = roof, antennae, top_strokes_*; OUTER = enclosure_strokes, brackets, side_strokes_*; INNER = inner_line, inner_dot, crossbar. Relative position = index/(length-1), texts of 2+ signs. Statistic: base mean relative position minus variant mean, per pair, weighted by variant count over pairs where both occur. Null: variant/base labels permuted within each pair. Exploration: +0.24 (p 0.0005, 547 marked tokens); 10 of 12 marked signs with 4+ uses sit earlier. Caveat: the jar family (G741-G746) and fish family (G235, G240) carry most tokens; Wells (1998, 2006) describes marked jars after the opening cluster G920 G60. Planned support: about 130 marked tokens, from the exploration count and the 80/20 split, not from the holdout; below the project minimum of 15 is reported as below planned support. One-sided. Benjamini-Hochberg across all confirmatory tests.
note: Statistic: base minus variant mean relative position, weighted by variant count. Null: variant/base labels permuted within each pair's tokens.
q_BH_scope: within the new-set batch (24 tests with a p-value)
